name: Spirit’s Enemy
body:
Your spirit guide bestows its wrath upon some foes in particular.

Prerequisite(s): Spirit guardian class feature.

Benefit(s): Choose a creature type from the ranger favored enemies table that isn’t normally affected by your spirit guardian ability. You gain your bonus from spirit guardian and spirit warrior when battling this creature type.
